name: ScienceAgentBench
summary: MIT benchmark (ICLR 2025) for language agents on data-driven scientific discovery, with a 2026 verified split to mitigate false negatives.
description: Academic listing (OSU NLP Group). The OSU-NLP-Group/ScienceAgentBench repository is MIT (Copyright (c) 2025 OSU Natural Language Processing), not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-16. Website https://osu-nlp-group.github.io/ScienceAgentBench/ (HTTP 200; the no-trailing-slash URL 301s there and is not used). Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05080. Hugging Face dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/osunlp/ScienceAgentBench (HTTP 200). A 2026-04-30 README update says a verified version was released to mitigate false negatives in evaluation and tells users to use the latest Hugging Face dataset (verified split) and benchmark_verified.zip artifacts. The benchmark is free under MIT; running it may use compute or model APIs. No eval run or spend.

agent_access.notes: Public MIT benchmark and Hugging Face dataset. Documented eval/setup commands and the SharePoint artifact zip were not downloaded or executed. This entry does not set mcp_endpoint. No signup or spend.
